channel.title: Signal vs. Noise
channel.description:
Signal vs. Noise is an AI-hosted podcast network covering tech, finance, crypto, and health — with zero sponsors, zero positions, and zero agenda. Our AI hosts debate the biggest stories using data, evidence, and genuine disagreement. No hype. No shilling. Just the signal.
Shows: Tech & AI (Sun) — Eric vs. Bella on AI, automation, and tech policy. Finance (Mon + Fri) — Marcus vs. James on markets, investing, and your money. Crypto (Tue + Thu) — Marcus vs. James on on-chain data and token analysis. Health (Wed + Sat) — Zara reviews the evidence behind wellness claims.
Subscribe to the network feed for all shows, or follow individual channels.
Topics: AI, stock market, cryptocurrency, Bitcoin, health science, investing, personal finance, nutrition, DeFi, sleep science, evidence-based analysis.

item.title: GPT-5: End of Coding Jobs?
item.description:

item.title: Melatonin: The Hormone Bomb in Your Medicine Cabinet — Evidence Score 6/10
item.description:
Seventy million Americans take melatonin. Most are taking ten times the clinical dose, at the wrong time, for the wrong reason. Zara breaks down what the research actually shows about melatonin efficacy, the alarming new heart failure data from a 130,000-person observational study, and the one population where the evidence is genuinely strong. No supplement deals. Just the science.
Timestamps: 00:00 — Cold Open 01:00 — Topic Frame 02:00 — Segment 1 07:00 — Segment 2 13:00 — Segment 3 16:00 — The Verdict
Sources cited in this episode: • Ferracioli-Oda et al. meta-analysis (19 RCTs, n=1,683) — melatonin reduced sleep onset latency by ~7 • Nnadi et al. (SUNY Downstate, presented AHA Scientific Sessions 2025) — TriNetX observational study, • Analysis of 34 melatonin supplements — only 22-48% met label claims within 10% margin; absorption in • RCT on REM sleep behavior disorder — 2 mg nightly for 6 months reduced symptom severity by ~50% in f • Multicenter RCT (melatonin 3 mg vs. amitriptyline 25 mg vs. placebo, 12 weeks) — equivalent ~50% mig
Next episode: Next time: CBT-I — cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia. It outperforms sleep medication in head-to-head trials. So why does almost nobody use it? We're getting into that.

item.title: Fed Silence on Tariffs: What Powell Isn't Saying Could Reshape Your 401k
item.description:
This week, the Fed held rates steady and Powell addressed tariffs directly at his March press conference — but what he chose to emphasize, and what he didn't, is the real story. Marcus and James break down what the 10.5% effective tariff rate (highest since 1943) means for your portfolio, whether inflation is truly transitory, and what you should actually do with your 401k right now.
Timestamps: 00:00 — Cold Open 01:00 — Market Pulse 03:00 — Segment 1 08:00 — Segment 2 14:00 — Segment 3 19:00 — What To Watch
Sources cited in this episode: • Powell March 2026 FOMC Press Conference — tariffs pose more significant inflation risk than oil pric • Budget Lab at Yale, March 9 2026 — U.S. average effective tariff rate at 10.5%, highest since 1943 e • FOMC Minutes January 28 2026 — federal funds rate held at 3.5-3.75%; real GDP projected to outpace p • FOMC January 29 2026 Decision — interest rate on reserve balances at 3.65%; primary credit rate at 3 • Federal Reserve Survey, reported March 5 2026 — small businesses raising prices due to Trump adminis
Next episode: Next week we're watching the Section 122 tariff clock — 150 days is ticking, and when that expiration hits, the effective tariff rate could drop from 10.5% to 7.3% overnight. What does that mean for consumer stocks and the dollar? We'll have the numbers.

item.title: Smart Money or Smart Exit? The Bitcoin ETF Flow Reversal — On-Chain Verdict
item.description:
Bitcoin ETF flows just flipped from the worst outflow streak of 2026 to a $1.47B two-week inflow surge — then reversed again in days. This week, Marcus and James dig into the on-chain data to answer the real question: is institutional money loading Bitcoin, or is this a head-fake before the next leg down? The $56B cumulative ETF base, the 57% supply-in-profit signal, and the Fed's latest hawkish pivot all point to a market at a genuine inflection point.
Timestamps: 00:00 — Cold Open 01:00 — Market Check 03:00 — Segment 1 07:00 — Segment 2 13:00 — Segment 3 16:00 — On Chain Watch
Sources cited in this episode: • CoinShares / ETF flow aggregators — $787M weekly BTC ETF inflows week ending March 5, 2026, ending 5 • CoinShares / ETF flow aggregators — $250M+ net inflows on March 10, 2026 • CoinShares / ETF flow aggregators — $199.37M net inflows on March 17, 2026, extending $1.47B two-wee • CoinShares / ETF flow aggregators — $129.62M net outflows on March 18, 2026, ending 7-day inflow str • CoinShares / ETF flow aggregators — $219.5M outflows following March 18 reversal
Next episode: Next time: Ethereum is quietly bleeding ETF market share to Bitcoin — is the ETH/BTC ratio telling us something the price isn't? We've got the flow data and it's not pretty for ETH holders.
